svg.title: Set up a new project
svg.desc: A reusable skill at ~/.claude/skills/project-scaffold/ contains SKILL.md and templates/paper.md and templates/website.md. Two Claude Code app panels show /project-scaffold with different purposes and destinations. A slate-uniformed agent creates and checks papers/attendance/, with data, code, outputs and manuscript folders and CLAUDE.md, STATUS.md, TASKS.md, SPECIFICATION.md and METHODOLOGY.md. A mustard-uniformed agent creates and checks websites/group-site/, with pages, assets and styles folders and CLAUDE.md, STATUS.md, TASKS.md and DESIGN.md. Both project locations are paths within the workspace. Folder-shaped containers show each output's directory tree. The skill creates starting structures, not completed projects.
